appInfo.name: DeskFit
appInfo.description: Smart exercise reminders for healthier work days

releases.title: DeskFit 2.0
highlights: The plant: your streak and progress grow a plant you look after, with stages, badges and a weekly target.
Notch mode: on a Mac with a notch, reminders and exercises appear in the notch. Menu bar only is still available.
New Settings: Schedule, Exercises, Progress and General, with a library you can edit and add your own exercises to.
Onboarding: a short four-step setup on first launch.
Diagnostics with opt-out: usage counts and crash reports help improve DeskFit, including the names of exercises you add. Turn them off during onboarding or in Settings > General.

releases.title: TelemetryDeck Critical Fix
highlights: CRITICAL: Fixed TelemetryDeck analytics collection - v0.5.0 users were not sending data
Reduced event batching from 5 events/5min to 3 events/1min for more responsive analytics
Added app termination and system shutdown flush to prevent data loss
Implemented unique device UUID tracking (replaces anonymous users)
Improved analytics reliability from ~10% to ~95% event delivery
All AppUpdater features from v0.5.0 remain fully functional

releases.title: AppUpdater Migration
highlights: AppUpdater Integration - Modern GitHub Releases-based update system
Simplified Updates - No manual appcast.xml management
Full Apple notarization and Gatekeeper approval
Universal Binary - Native support for Intel (x86_64) and Apple Silicon (arm64)
Enhanced stability with improved error handling
Complete icon system for all macOS sizes
All features working on macOS 14.0+

releases.title: Universal Binary Support
highlights: Universal binary - works on both Intel (x86_64) and Apple Silicon (arm64) Macs
Native performance on both processor types
Single app bundle for all Mac users
Enhanced stability and performance optimizations
Bug fixes and improvements

releases.title: Enhanced Performance
highlights: Enhanced performance and stability
UI/UX improvements and optimizations
Complete signing with Apple Developer ID
Bug fixes and code refinements
